A prominent '''member''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Senate]] took interest in the [[Human/Legends|Human]] student [[Harsh]] while the young man studied at an [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Senator/Legends|senator]] befriend the boy and taught him in the ways of [[Politics/Legends|politics]], showing Harsh that he must win political victories as well as military ones. With the senators help, Harsh graduated the academy with the highest honors and was quickly promoted up through the ranks of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], eventually becoming [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Cauldron (Imperial-class)|''Cauldron'']].<ref name="SWG6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The senator was first mentioned in "[[Unusual Suspects]]" and article written by [[Andrew Hind]] and published in [[West End Games]]'s [[Star Wars Gamer 6]]. The article did not clarify the senator's [[Species/Legends|species]] or [[Gender/Legends|gender]].
